name: SHENZHEN TOPRAYSOLAR Co.,Ltd.
summary: SHENZHEN TOPRAYSOLAR Co.,Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sale of solar cell chips and components in China. The company operates through four segments: Silicon Wafer Division; Modules and Other Photovoltaic Products Business Unit; Photovoltaic Power Plant Business Unit; and Others. It offers solar power supplies, application products, photovoltaic glass and brackets, and collector plates, as well as water heater systems; and designs, installs, and sells, solar hot water projects, solar power station, and wind power projects.
